finalists.label: Pauci-immune focal necrotizing glomerulonephritis
finalists.why: Elevated PR3-ANCA and rheumatoid factor concentrations and segmental sclerotic glomeruli support this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Glomerulonephritis
finalists.why: Urinary protein excretion, microhaematuria, and low serum complement C3 concentrations are findings that support glomerulonephritis.

finalists.label: Immune Complex Glomerulonephritis
finalists.why: Low serum complement C3 concentrations and segmental sclerotic glomeruli are consistent with immune complex glomerulonephritis.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of elevated PR3-ANCA and rheumatoid factor concentrations and segmental sclerotic glomeruli specifically support the champion diagnosis over the runner-up.
